about: Diagnostic switches of the pinned build and the harness: README.md explains the fields and levels; check_switches.py compares this with the pinned sources

switches.name: nx2:vi2 last 600 presents
switches.purpose: Lichii's own frame counter: mean and max frame time, hitches over 100 ms, GPU fence wait, composite, presents run a frame ahead, vblanks asked against real time
switches.output: log: nx2:vi2 last 600 presents: frame N us (max N, N over 100 ms), …
switches.hazards: counts game presents, menus and loading included; one line covers about 10 s, so it is placed by the time it was written

switches.name: Runtime pipelines in the last 10 s
switches.purpose: pipelines built at run time and their GPU-thread ms
switches.output: log: Runtime pipelines in the last 10 s: N built, …
switches.reader: tools/harness/ab.py (BUILD_RE: settle and the builds count per phase)

switches.name: Bounded pipeline wait
switches.purpose: time the GPU thread waited for pipelines still building
switches.output: log: Bounded pipeline wait: N ms spent in the last 10 s

switches.name: Background prebuild
switches.purpose: the boot's background pipeline prebuild finishing
switches.output: log: Background prebuild done N s after the boot load began

switches.name: pipeline build failed
switches.purpose: a graphics pipeline the driver could not build
switches.output: log: Graphics pipeline build failed: …

switches.name: JIT code cache flush requested
switches.purpose: a JIT flush asked for (debug server jit_clear, EDEN_NX2_JIT_FLUSH_ON_STALL)
switches.output: log: JIT code cache flush requested (why), generation N

switches.name: Module main loaded at
switches.purpose: load address of each guest module (ASLR: differs every boot)
switches.output: log: Module NAME loaded at 0x… (size 0x…)

switches.name: Unhandled guest exception
switches.purpose: a guest exception the CPU backend could not handle
switches.output: log (critical): Unhandled guest exception: syndrome …, pc …
switches.hazards: only the Hypervisor backend writes this text (src/core/arm/hvf/arm_hvf.cpp); a guest crash under dynarmic leaves other lines, so ab.py's crash check does not recognise it

switches.name: Device fault
switches.purpose: after a Vulkan device loss: what VK_EXT_device_fault reports
switches.output: log (critical): Device fault: …, Device fault address N: …
switches.hazards: Lichii exits after a device loss

switches.name: Memory trace
switches.purpose: on the first failed device allocation: process commit, heaps and their budgets
switches.output: log: Memory trace: …
switches.hazards: the same prefix every 2 s with EDEN_NX2_MEM_TRACE

switches.name: [mvk-diag] mesh position fixup
switches.purpose: the mesh position fix applied to a mesh shader as it is compiled (off with MVK_ALLINONE_NO_MESH_FLIP)
switches.output: stderr: [mvk-diag] mesh position fixup added (N mesh shaders so far)
switches.reader: tools/harness/ab.py (boot progress in the window title)

switches.name: stderr.log
switches.purpose: Lichii's stdout and stderr for the run
switches.output: {rd}/stderr.log

switches.name: hang-sample.txt
switches.purpose: a 3 s macOS sample of Lichii when the boot hangs
switches.output: {rd}/hang-sample.txt

switches.name: rss_mb / footprint_mb
switches.purpose: resident memory (ps) and footprint (footprint -p) at the end of the stand
switches.output: result.json rss_mb, footprint_mb

switches.name: loadavg_before / loadavg_after
switches.purpose: the machine's load average around the run
switches.output: result.json

switches.name: fail_status / fail_log
switches.purpose: on an error: debug server status, the last 40 log lines and a screenshot
switches.output: result.json fail_status, fail_log, fail_shot; {rd}/fail.png

switches.name: settle_builds / builds
switches.purpose: pipeline-build lines while settling and per phase
switches.output: result.json settle_builds, builds

switches.name: picture
switches.purpose: the end picture's corruption score (persist.picture_metrics on run-stand2.png)
switches.output: result.json picture; run-*.png

switches.name: t_uptime / t_monotonic
switches.purpose: every harness step on CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW and CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW (the clock table)
switches.output: result.json t_uptime, t_monotonic

switches.name: frames.bin
switches.purpose: the verify hook's timestamp of every presented frame (CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW ns)
switches.output: {rd}/frames.bin (little-endian u64 per present)
switches.cost: none measured; every harness run has it
switches.hazards: indices are presents; result.json marks index it
switches.verdict: The clock every figure rests on: percentiles, bands and 300-frame walk segments

switches.name: frame_times
switches.purpose: guest-present interval statistics and a VSync histogram over a timed window
switches.output: debug server reply
switches.verdict: The guest's own present times, to compare with the hook's clock

switches.name: record_frame_times
switches.purpose: Lichii's own frame-time CSV
switches.output: a CSV beside the log, written on a clean exit
switches.hazards: written only on a clean exit: nothing under kill -9, so never in a harness run

switches.name: status-bar FPS
switches.purpose: the window's fps readout
switches.output: the status bar
switches.hazards: freezes in background captures and shows 60 FPS where the frame clock does not (KNOWN-ISSUES KI-8): never a measurement

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_FPS_LOG
switches.purpose: the command-line frontend's FPS, speed and frame time as log lines
switches.output: log: FPS: N speed: N% frametime: N ms
switches.hazards: command-line frontend (eden-cli) only; the app the harness runs never writes it

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_STUTTER_TRACE
switches.purpose: frames over 33 ms with their top cause and each GPU thread's ms, a 10 s summary, boot steps, and with it each core's JIT totals
switches.output: log: Nx2Stutter, Nx2StutterDetail, Nx2StutterSummary, Nx2Boot … mono_s=, JIT totals core=
switches.cost: not measured (it is the reference of the 2026-11-19 walks: walk median 18.8-19.1 ms, two runs, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-085549 (local run data, not tracked))
switches.hazards: Nx2Stutter only for frames over 33 ms (constexpr StutterMs), so no line for an ordinary frame; frame= counts the trace's presents, not the harness's; jit_cache_mib 6x too high with the shared cache (KI-6); Nx2Boot is the only line that maps log time to the monotonic clock
switches.verdict: Names the JIT compile frames (blocks and compile time per slow frame) and places the log on the harness clock

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_STUTTER_DETAIL_MS
switches.purpose: frame time over which Nx2StutterDetail adds each thread's largest zones and rare sites (default 50)
switches.output: log: Nx2StutterDetail
switches.cost: not measured (on in every 2026-11-19 walk at 200)

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_STUTTER_ALL_FRAMES
switches.purpose: an Nx2Stutter line for every frame, to see where an ordinary frame goes
switches.output: log: Nx2Stutter for every frame
switches.cost: walk median 19.1 and 19.9 ms against 18.8-19.1 ms (two runs, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-090845 (local run data, not tracked), labels walkcap-allframes-r1/r2)
switches.hazards: about 2.7 MB of log per walk
switches.verdict: Showed the p95 frames are not compile frames (0.3 ms of compile in them) and that a frame is about 1.1 ms longer per ms of compile time

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_GUEST_THREAD_STATS
switches.purpose: per frame, the guest threads with the most core time and where it went; per core, JIT exits, lookups, compiles, counter reads, hints; turns ACQUIRE_STATS on
switches.output: log: Guest threads over 10.0 s, the per-thread lines, Guest core N over 10.0 s
switches.cost: walk median 19.9 ms with EDEN_NX2_GUEST_THREAD_STATS (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-090328 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-dkb)
switches.verdict: The game's main thread is on a core 7.2 ms a frame and waits 11.6 ms: the game is not the limit

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_GUEST_THREAD_STATS_SLOW_MS
switches.purpose: with EDEN_NX2_GUEST_THREAD_STATS, makes each report window one present-to-present interval and logs only windows at least this many ms long: what every guest thread did in each slow frame
switches.output: log: Guest threads over 0.0NNN s, the per-thread lines, Guest core N lines, one block per slow window
switches.cost: walk median 19.8 ms with EDEN_NX2_GUEST_THREAD_STATS_SLOW_MS=28 (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walk at the Kokiri spawn, load average 9; run ab-20261119-094316 (local run data, not tracked), label probe-threads-r1)
switches.last_checked: test build of 2026-11-19 from the pinned trees (wip/walk-tail/build-test-app.sh; run ab-20261119-094316, local run data, not tracked)
switches.hazards: only in patches/experiments/lichii-thread-stats-slow-frames-2026-11-19.patch: needs a test build in a private data root; the window is between guest presents, which is not the hook's present-to-present interval, so match a block to its frame by the Nx2Stutter line that follows it; figures are per present in the window
switches.verdict: In late frames under load, several worker threads sat ready without a core for about 10 or 20 ms at once

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_GPU_PROFILE
switches.purpose: GPU thread, back thread and Vulkan worker time per second by zone, waits by zone and site, spin-mutex contention; turns ACQUIRE_STATS on
switches.output: log: <thread> per second: | zone N ms (N/s) | …, and more counters
switches.cost: walk median 22.5 ms against 18.8-19.1 ms: about 3 ms (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-091354 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-gpuprofile)
switches.hazards: its cost skews the frame times it explains: give it its own run
switches.verdict: Its fence decision line: of 2,400-2,800 fences made a second, 2,200-2,500 carry a query report the game reads

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_ACQUIRE_STATS
switches.purpose: the GPU front's semaphore acquires and its waits for the back by site
switches.output: log: Acquires:, GPU thread waits for suspended channels, Front waits for the back in 10 s by site, QMD view
switches.cost: walk median 19.8 ms with BACK_IDLE_TRACE, ACQUIRE_STATS and PRESENT_FENCE_TRACE together (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-091354 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-backidle)
switches.verdict: Tested with the back idle trace: front waits of 2.6-2.8 ms a frame for list writers and 1.6-1.9 ms for acquires

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_BACK_IDLE_TRACE
switches.purpose: the GPU back thread's idle time split by what the front was doing
switches.output: log: Back idle in 10 s: …
switches.cost: walk median 19.8 ms with BACK_IDLE_TRACE, ACQUIRE_STATS and PRESENT_FENCE_TRACE together (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-091354 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-backidle)
switches.verdict: The GPU back thread idles 4.2-5.0 ms a frame, over half of it while the front waits on a semaphore between GPU channels

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_PRESENT_FENCE_TRACE
switches.purpose: presents by the state of their fence at entry and how long until it was reached
switches.output: log: nx2:vi2 present fences, last 600 presents: …
switches.cost: walk median 19.8 ms with BACK_IDLE_TRACE, ACQUIRE_STATS and PRESENT_FENCE_TRACE together (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-091354 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-backidle)
switches.verdict: Tested: every present's fence is reached about one frame later; nothing further

switches.name: EDEN_DKB_FRAME_TRACE
switches.purpose: present, renderer and CPU frame timing and one frame timed on the host GPU (DKB gpu_frame, its 16 costliest passes as DKB gpu_pass)
switches.output: log: DKB frame, DKB renderer, DKB cpu, DKB draws, DKB gpu_frame, DKB gpu_pass, DKB stale …
switches.cost: walk median 19.9 ms with EDEN_NX2_GUEST_THREAD_STATS (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-090328 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-dkb)
switches.hazards: its DKB frame and DKB gpu_frame lines are one sample a second, not every frame; on MoltenVK only gpu_pass times are real (gpu_work and gpu_site read 0 or overflowed values)
switches.verdict: Tested: one sample a second, too coarse for frame-level questions

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_HOSTTIMING_STATS
switches.purpose: CoreTiming's host waits: OS sleep and precise wait time, how late sleeps and events ended
switches.output: log: HostTiming wait: …
switches.cost: walk median 20.0 ms with HOSTTIMING_STATS and IDLE_STATS together (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-091354 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-timing)
switches.hazards: also switched live by the debug server's host_timing {"stats": true}
switches.verdict: Ruled out late timers: wake-ups late by under 0.1 ms at p99

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_IDLE_STATS
switches.purpose: guest cores' idle periods, how many the poll caught, wake-up latency
switches.output: log: Guest core N idle over 10.0 s: …
switches.cost: walk median 20.0 ms with HOSTTIMING_STATS and IDLE_STATS together (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-091354 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-timing)
switches.verdict: Ruled out slow core wake-ups: 15-18 us at p99

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_TRACE
switches.purpose: buffers created, joined and collected; SMMU ranges; each buffer of 64 MiB or more
switches.output: log: Buffer trace: …
switches.cost: walk median 19.4 ms with BUFFER_TRACE, TC_TRACE, DRAW_REUSE_PROBE and TC_LOG together (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-091354 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-caches)
switches.verdict: Tested: 80-144 buffers created a second while walking; no cause found in it

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_TC_LOG
switches.purpose: texture cache device memory against the collector's thresholds
switches.output: log: Texture cache: device memory N MiB (expected, critical), N images N MiB
switches.cost: walk median 19.4 ms with BUFFER_TRACE, TC_TRACE, DRAW_REUSE_PROBE and TC_LOG together (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-091354 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-caches)
switches.verdict: Tested: nothing the texture trace does not show

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_DRAW_REUSE_PROBE
switches.purpose: draws per frame by reuse class and their PrepareDraw cost
switches.output: log: Draw reuse per frame over N frames: …
switches.cost: walk median 19.4 ms with BUFFER_TRACE, TC_TRACE, DRAW_REUSE_PROBE and TC_LOG together (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-091354 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-caches)
switches.verdict: Tested: 4-8 images created per walking frame, which EDEN_NX2_TC_TRACE shows in more detail

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_DOWNLOAD_TRACE
switches.purpose: what the buffer cache copies back to guest memory at fences, and guest reads of GPU-written ranges
switches.output: log: Download trace, … in 10 s; Download trace: CPU read of GPU-written […) …
switches.cost: walk median 19.0 ms (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-091354 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-download)
switches.hazards: only the first 2,000 guest reads are logged (in that run the cap was reached during the walk); the 10 s lines appear only when something was copied back
switches.verdict: The game reads GPU-written memory about 0.8 times a frame while walking, 87 % of it in one 2 MiB region

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_MEM_TRACE
switches.purpose: what the texture and buffer caches hold next to what the process and driver report; and the title's first memory layout and size queries
switches.output: log: Memory trace: …
switches.hazards: the SVC part logs the first 200 queries per event
switches.verdict: What the buffer and texture caches hold every 2 s, against a growing footprint

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_LIST_MACRO_TRACE
switches.purpose: GPU-written command list entries the front waits for and the native macros they feed
switches.output: log: List macro trace in 10.0 s, List macro reader; list-macro-*.txt in EDEN_NX2_DEBUG_DIR
switches.verdict: Which GPU-written command lists the front waits for, by kind: whether more can be taken without waiting

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_FS_READ_TRACE
switches.purpose: guest RomFS and file reads: count, MiB, latency
switches.output: log: Guest storage reads, Guest file reads
switches.cost: not measured (one run on 2026-11-19 completed with it, run ab-20261119-093044 (local run data, not tracked), label fu-fsread)
switches.hazards: lines only while the guest reads
switches.verdict: Ruled out file reads: none over 1 ms while walking

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_HVF_STATS
switches.purpose: Hypervisor backend exits: SVCs, trapped system registers, faults
switches.output: log: Hypervisor exits per second
switches.hazards: Hypervisor backend only (not the pinned build's CPU backend)

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_IPC_SUMMARY
switches.purpose: how often each service command ran and with which result
switches.output: log: IPC summary lines
switches.verdict: Service calls every 5 s: whether a service is busy during slow frames

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_MME_MEMO_STATS
switches.purpose: the macro memo's counters
switches.output: log: memo counters

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_CMDPAGE_DIAG
switches.purpose: command list pages that GPU work writes: whether it writes the lists' own words, and what the front's slow path costs
switches.output: log: counts

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_TC_TRACE
switches.purpose: every image the texture cache creates, uploads, deletes or makes over stale pages
switches.output: log: TCTRACE create / delete / upload / stale-skip
switches.cost: walk median 19.4 ms with BUFFER_TRACE, TC_TRACE, DRAW_REUSE_PROBE and TC_LOG together (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-091354 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-caches)
switches.hazards: about 30,000 lines a walk (9.8 MB of log with the other cache switches)
switches.verdict: Ruled out texture churn as the trigger of stalls; 4-8 images are created and deleted per walking frame

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_PIPELINE_BUILD_TRACE
switches.purpose: a flushed BEGIN / END line per driver pipeline build with the stage hashes and wall time
switches.output: the file it names
switches.hazards: times include waiting on other builds
switches.verdict: Time of each driver pipeline build: first visits to an area

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_PIPELINE_DIFF
switches.purpose: for a new pipeline whose shaders an earlier one uses, which fixed state differs
switches.output: log
switches.verdict: Which state made each new pipeline: first visits to an area

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_READBLOCK_TRACE
switches.purpose: every read of unmapped device memory with its caller (else the first 16)
switches.output: log: Unmapped Device ReadBlock …

switches.name: MVK_FRAMEPROF
switches.purpose: MoltenVK's frame profiler: GPU start and end of every command buffer, its encoders summed by signature, every 150th frame encoder by encoder
switches.output: {rd}/frameprof.txt (records P, T, C, S, E)
switches.cost: walk median 19.8 ms in both runs with MVK_FRAMEPROF and P60_SYNC_TRACE together (1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-090328 (local run data, not tracked), labels walkcap-gpu-r1/r2); an earlier build measured its own overhead under 0.2 ms (research/allinone-frame-breakdown)
switches.hazards: E records only for frames where frame % 150 == 0 (dump in MVKFrameProf.mm); about 46-48 MB per walk; host clock is mach_absolute_time in us
switches.verdict: GPU busy against idle for every frame; found the command buffers that stall and the fixed cost of about 0.3-0.4 ms per command buffer

switches.name: MVK_FRAMEPROF_DUMP_MS
switches.purpose: with MVK_FRAMEPROF, also writes the per-encoder E records of every command buffer whose GPU interval is at least this many ms, so a stalled command buffer shows which pass waited
switches.output: {rd}/frameprof.txt (E records after the long command buffer's S records)
switches.cost: walk median 19.6 ms with MVK_FRAMEPROF, P60_SYNC_TRACE and MVK_FRAMEPROF_DUMP_MS=6 (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walk at the Kokiri spawn, load average 9; run ab-20261119-094316 (local run data, not tracked), label probe-encoders-r1)
switches.last_checked: test build of 2026-11-19 from the pinned trees (wip/walk-tail/build-test-app.sh; run ab-20261119-094316, local run data, not tracked)
switches.hazards: only in patches/experiments/moltenvk-frameprof-dump-long-buffers-2026-11-19.patch: needs a test build in a private data root
switches.verdict: Showed a stalled command buffer is one gap between two passes, of 7-11 ms or about twice that, with nothing between 2 and 7 ms

switches.name: P60_SYNC_TRACE
switches.purpose: a line per synchronisation event: frontwait, gpuwait, hostwait, flush, finish, copy, copy-batched, copy-reordered
switches.output: {rd}/sync.txt (<ns> <tag> <where> <a> <b>)
switches.cost: walk median 19.8 ms in both runs with MVK_FRAMEPROF and P60_SYNC_TRACE together (1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-090328 (local run data, not tracked), labels walkcap-gpu-r1/r2)
switches.hazards: 200-250 MB per walk; CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW ns
switches.verdict: Classes each slow frame without the profiler (JIT compile, read wait, late start, mid gap) and showed the game waits on about 8.6 fences a frame

switches.name: MVK_CONFIG_PERFORMANCE_TRACKING
switches.purpose: MoltenVK's own activity performance counters
switches.output: stderr (MoltenVK log)
switches.verdict: MoltenVK's own timing of command buffer encoding and submission: what is inside the fixed cost per command buffer

switches.name: MVK_CONFIG_LOG_LEVEL
switches.purpose: MoltenVK's log level (tools/verify runs with 2, errors)
switches.output: stderr

switches.name: MVK_CONFIG_TRACE_VULKAN_CALLS
switches.purpose: a line per Vulkan call MoltenVK receives
switches.output: stderr
switches.hazards: per call: tens of thousands a frame

switches.name: MVK_CONFIG_DEBUG
switches.purpose: MoltenVK debug mode (shader conversion logging and checks)
switches.output: stderr

switches.name: DYNARMIC_JIT_TRACE
switches.purpose: every code cache operation: lookups that missed a Jit's table, compiles with their guest instructions, fastmem faults, invalidations, clears
switches.output: {rd}/jit-trace.bin (32-byte records)
switches.cost: walk median 19.2 ms with ALL_FRAMES (one run, 1,800-frame leashed walks at the Kokiri spawn, load average 6-10; run ab-20261119-090845 (local run data, not tracked), label walkcap-jitrec); the file was 445 MB for one boot, save load and walk
switches.hazards: its clock starts at the first record; replays offline with DYNARMIC_JIT_REPLAY in the PR #2101 test tree
switches.verdict: What is compiled and when: 73 % of a walk's compiles are first compiles, 27 % recompiles after a fault; replays offline in the test bench

switches.name: DYNARMIC_BLOCK_MAP
switches.purpose: host entry, size and guest PC range of every compiled arm64 block
switches.output: the file it names (text, line buffered)
switches.verdict: Host address to guest block, to name JIT code in a sample

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_JIT_SYMBOLS
switches.purpose: names of JIT blocks for the Windows sampler
switches.output: none on macOS
switches.hazards: takes a process-wide lock per compiled block; only the Windows sampler reads the names

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_JIT_LOG
switches.purpose: one record per compiled block: core, guest PC, time in each compile phase
switches.output: {rd}/jit.bin (40-byte records)
switches.last_checked: test build of 2026-11-17 (research/emulator-options; run ab-20261117-190501, local run data, not tracked)
switches.hazards: only in patches/experiments/dynarmic-jit-log-2026-11-17.patch: needs a test build in a private data root
switches.verdict: Time per compile stage for every block; last run on a build before the shared code cache. Needs a test build

switches.name: DYNARMIC_ARM64_REGION_SIZE
switches.purpose: test setting: smaller code regions, so veneers happen in a small cache
switches.output: none
switches.hazards: changes code generation: never for a measurement

switches.name: sample
switches.purpose: macOS's stack sampler on a running Lichii
switches.output: a text report
switches.cost: pauses the process while it samples (TRACKER.md, measurement rules)
switches.last_checked: the harness takes a 3 s sample of a hung boot (hang-sample.txt)
switches.hazards: never during a measured phase
switches.verdict: On the offline replay of a JIT recording: register allocator bookkeeping is a third of compile work and instruction encoding 3 %

switches.name: EDEN_NX2_SAMPLE
switches.purpose: Lichii's built-in thread sampler
switches.output: EDEN_NX2_SAMPLE_OUT
switches.hazards: Windows only (src/common/nx2_sampler.cpp)

switches.name: sample (debug call)
switches.purpose: the built-in sampler through the debug server
switches.output: debug server reply
switches.hazards: Windows only: returns 'the sampler is Windows only'

switches.name: footprint
switches.purpose: macOS's memory footprint of a process
switches.output: text
switches.cost: none measured; the harness runs it once after the stand

switches.name: metalperftrace
switches.purpose: Apple's always-on Metal performance record: per second, for each program that draws through a Metal layer, frames, time on the GPU, CPU begin-to-present time, drawable wait; resource use per process
switches.output: `metalperftrace collect --last 10m DIR` writes an .atrc file for any past window; `metalperftrace overview [--json --json-include-timeline] FILE` prints it
switches.cost: collect is passive (the record is always on); listen hung two runs (TRACKER.md)
switches.last_checked: macOS 27.0.1, 2026-11-19: collect and overview work; the last ten minutes listed lichii and iTerm2 only (not the window compositor or other apps)
switches.hazards: per second and per program, with nothing per pass: it cannot show who had the GPU inside one frame; its earlier reader (mpt_report.py) is lost; never attach listen
switches.verdict: Tested: per second and per program, with only lichii and iTerm2 listed; cannot show who has the GPU inside a frame

switches.name: powermetrics
switches.purpose: Apple's sampler of CPU time per program and of GPU power and idle time, every 100 ms or more
switches.output: `sudo powermetrics --samplers tasks,gpu_power --show-process-gpu -i 100 -n N`: text, one block per sample
switches.cost: not measured (the walk it sampled ran at a 19.9 ms median)
switches.last_checked: macOS 27.0.1, 2026-11-19 (run ab-20261119-103808, local run data, not tracked)
switches.hazards: needs sudo; its GPU time per program reads 0.00 for every program on this macOS, so it cannot say who has the GPU; samples come about 113 ms apart at -i 100
switches.verdict: Tested: GPU time per program reads zero; did show the emulator at 7.3 cores and the GPU idle 80 % of the time without it

switches.name: shotwatch
switches.purpose: asks the frame hook for a window capture ten times a second beside a running harness batch, scores each one and keeps only the captures with a wrong picture (clipped white), with a CSV line for every capture; can take a bug bundle and a GPU trace when a boot comes up bad
switches.output: OUT_DIR/shots.csv, bad-*.png, ref-*.png
switches.cost: about 40-50 ms per capture on the hook's control thread; walk median 19.5 ms and p95 23.2 ms during a 20 s watch against 19.6 and 24.2 ms before it in the same walk (one sample; run ab-20261119-093044 (local run data, not tracked), label fu-fsread)
switches.hazards: captures before presented frame 1,500 are never kept (the boot logos are white); a clean Kokiri Forest scene scores 0.0 % white and the canopy-shard picture 2.6-2.8 %; the bright-saturated score flags a yellow lantern near the camera, so it is off unless asked for
switches.verdict: Watched 22 boots in play for the canopy shards of KNOWN-ISSUES KI-29, all clean

switches.name: threadcpu
switches.purpose: CPU time of every thread of a running process over a window, by thread name, read through libproc without pausing the process and without sudo
switches.output: stdout: ms of CPU per second per thread name
switches.cost: none seen: the walk it read ran at a 19.8 ms median (one run; run ab-20261119-104210 (local run data, not tracked), label cpu-threads)
switches.hazards: reads two snapshots a window apart, so threads that start or end in between are miscounted
switches.verdict: The emulator uses 7.3 of 10 performance cores: six guest core threads 4.3, the three GPU threads 2.1

switches.name: Instruments / xctrace
